verdict.rationale: Brex's own integrations page claims automatic syncing across native integrations spanning card swipe to month-end close. It also documents an Accounting API and automated GL coding by entity, which points to first-party accounting sync. However, the evidence never names a specific accounting system or describes how transactions and expenses flow into one. Missing for 10: named accounting-software connectors (e.g. ERP/GL targets), documentation of what transaction and expense data syncs and how often, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can sync transactions and expenses automatically with my accounting software
